title: The Dragon issue-23 opener part three: the commentary set (census 875)

banner.title: The Dragon issue-23 opener part three - the six-chain commentary set
banner.provenance: The part-three round of the issue-23 four-round shape - six of the ten Curtiss-called chains pinned as the commentary set: the gaming-hobby trade-show report (print 6), the armor-weights polemic (print 14), the permanent-damage charts (print 19-20), the dungeon-as-prison formula (print 21), the Origins scheduling critique (print 4 and 21) and the Niall sword-and-sorcery tale (print 8-9 and 22-30, Gardner Fox and the witchwoman Sosaria Thota). All pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 9 (March 1979) at extract/dragon/023, PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE this issue, the transcript of the Curtiss-provided scan. The two inherited watches - the Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel - print nowhere in issue 23 and ride to TD 24.

audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r951_batch.h"  // R951: R951 issue-23 Lower Planes generation audit
audit_comment: THE SIX-CHAIN COMMENTARY SET AUDIT - the issue-23 part-three round: the trade-show roster, the armor and sword weights, the permanent-damage charts with their percentile bands, the Elrohir prison formula, the Kask Origins verdict and the Niall tale through the amanatlon device, print 6, 14, 19-20, 21, 4 plus 21 and 8-9 plus 22-30.
